results.title: The service: the legacy flows of fastmail-connect (upload, then view-only) and the Connect extension (upload, then editable, no callback)

Connect extension (default permissions, no callback): uploaded through /api/files/upload (internal fileUrl true); open 200 (key legacy.legacy-65d24b99-3256-43ae-8d99-b711bdad07a3.e0); DocumentServer drew the uploaded file; typed then force-save answered error 0 (want 0: edits reached the server)

results.title: The document profile in a real editor: no lock option, no Protection tab, no AI tab, no Plugins tab; what "Remove content control" does

results.title: A service restart between an edit and the save still delivers the save (stateless sessions)
evidence: after restarting the service, the final save reached the consumer true, signed true, holding the edit true

results.title: A consumer that is down (503) or refusing (401) at the final save, then recovered within the retry horizon, receives the save
evidence: consumer answering 503 twice: 3 delivery attempt(s) (503, 503, 200); the third delivered the save true holding the edit true; one deliveryId across attempts true
consumer answering 401 twice: 3 delivery attempt(s) (401, 401, 200); the third delivered the save true holding the edit true; one deliveryId across attempts true

results.title: Drop through the service: with edits the consumer gets the final save, without edits a closed notification
evidence: with edits: drop answered 200 {"result":"ok"}; terminal notification saved; holds the edit true
no edits: drop answered 200 {"result":"ok"}; terminal notification closed
another consumer dropping this consumer's key: 403

results.title: Tampered and unknown editor tokens show the expired page; refusals at open
